body:
Textures by Torrezx follow them at https://x.com/TorrezxMC

Ionite Mod adds a brand new material to Minecraft — Ionite — a rare gemstone found deep underground. Mine Ionite Ore to collect Raw Ionite, smelt it into Ionite Gems, and craft a complete set of tools, armor, a bow, and a crossbow. Ionite offers diamond-tier performance with unique green energy aesthetics, making it a powerful upgrade for any adventurer.
